- **Abuse catalogue:** none of the cheats apply to an intro sentence, and I found no new ones to add.
- **Stage B:** all 5 verdicts are "not-related" (the code lines only share page 176 with this unit), so no scenario changes or scenario-notes rows are needed.
- **Rulings:** I proposed none.
- **Files:** I changed nothing.

The definitions themselves are tested under their own GLOSS.* units.
